title: Idea for a EA trading strategy
author: Different-Team6219
selftext: Forgive me if what I’m saying makes no sense. A lot of breakout EA’s require significant volatility/large movements for success and can fail due to lack of these. Could an EA analyse the VIX which prices in the predicted level of movement in the S&P and only trade when above a certain level increasing chance of breakout being successful due to almost guaranteed large movement.

comments.author: CommandantZ
comments.body:
Professional EA developer here,

"Could" ? Sure it could, everything is doable and programmable.

Would it be profitable ? I don't know enough of the VIX to know that. Also, your sentence "which prices in the predicted level of movement in the S&P" is a bit difficult to understand. Maybe try to reformulate.

Good luck as well!

comments.author: No_Analysis91
comments.body: Vix predicts the move not the direction. As the vix rises the spread widens and you eat the edge in cost.
